core.title: Solid Brass Extension Flush Bolts, Baldwin 0600

text.description_html:
Baldwin Extension Flush Door Bolt

Flush bolts (also know as door edge bolts) are installed into the edge of the door and have a toggle lever that is moved up and down to push the attached rod and bolt into a header or threshold (footer), which locks or unlocks an inactive door.

These extension flush bolts are designed with a unique cam mechanism which allows a smooth open-close sliding action. This eliminates springs which can break or jam.

The guide design and flat side of the door bolt head prevents the bolt from rotating.

If Measuring an existing Extension Flush bolt for replacement: Measure from the "Flip Lever" to the "Door Bolt Head".

Specifications of Baldwin 0600 Extension Flush Bolt

  • Rod Length: 12"
  • Bolt Throw: 3/4"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
Handle Plate
  • Length - 6-3/4"
  • Width - 1"
Strike Plate
  • Length - 2-1/4"
  • Width - 15/16"
Guide Plate
  • Length - 2"
  • Width - 1"

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.
